stages.name: Starter
stages.promise: One workflow runs through your AI, better, with a human reviewing.

stages.name: Intermediate
stages.promise: The system remembers your world, captures what happens, and holds your commitments.
stages.gate: Memory stays current and the routine is in use.

stages.name: Expert
stages.promise: A bounded operator does real recurring work inside enforced limits.
stages.gate: Limits enforced; stop and restore drills pass.

stages.name: Frontier Operator
stages.promise: Proven work is automated where justified; the system survives tool changes and your absence.

lanes.personal: The weekly plan you rewrite every Sunday, or the trip you replan every time a date moves.
lanes.business: The maintenance request that arrives by text and gets lost before anyone owns it.

sections.title: Know me
artifacts: Workflow context brief with a Never-do block

lanes.personal: A weekly planning draft that respects the hours you actually have.
lanes.business: A vendor reply that uses the company's priorities and knows who may approve work.

sections.title: Learn my work
sections.provenance: Interview 7, with Interview 8-lite as its real-use step
artifacts: One acceptable and one unacceptable example

lanes.personal: A weekly research brief with sources, run by hand with you reviewing.
lanes.business: A maintenance request triaged and the next step drafted from the approved procedure.

lanes.personal: Telling a confirmed booking from an old itinerary.
lanes.business: A rent summary that cannot silently replace the operative lease and its amendments.

sections.title: Remember my world
sections.provenance: Interview 3, with the Session Protocol module as its mechanism

lanes.personal: Recovering why a project was deferred, months later, from the record.
lanes.business: Recovering why a vendor was chosen and what restrictions came with that choice.

sections.title: Capture and commit
artifacts: Commitment rules and the current-quarter page

lanes.personal: A travel-change email becomes a review item; a renewal notice becomes a dated review.
lanes.business: A maintenance request enters intake with the original message attached; a promised quote gets an owner and a follow-up date.

sections.title: Know your limits
sections.provenance: Interview 6, with the Security Baseline module as its second artifact
artifacts: Action matrix with approval rules, three zones
Security baseline: credential inventory, sensitivity rules, incident plan

lanes.personal: Drafting a reply to your landlord is allowed; sending it, or paying anything, waits for you.
lanes.business: Preparing a vendor response may be allowed; sending it or authorizing spend follows the owner's approval rule.

sections.title: Help me operate
artifacts: Bounded operator brief with run log

lanes.personal: A weekly briefing of your commitments and project changes, prepared before you ask.
lanes.business: A maintenance triage assistant that prepares a source-backed recommendation for review.

sections.title: Automate the proven work
artifacts: Automation decision map, including documented remain-assisted decisions

lanes.personal: A confirmed appointment change produces a draft follow-up and waits for your approval.
lanes.business: A confirmed incoming request produces a draft follow-up, waits for approval, and never sends twice.

sections.title: Improve and survive
artifacts: Operating review and recovery plan with 30, 90, 180, 365 dates

lanes.personal: A second tool runs your week from the exported vault and nothing is lost.
lanes.business: A colleague resumes a recurring process from the records during your absence.
